sections.heading: How to wear ?
sections.text:
-> Best day to wear the Ambition Protection Bracelet is Sunday morning when your intention is confidence, courage, and leadership.
-> Wear the Ambition Protection Bracelet on your wrist as part of your daily routine—at work, during meetings, while travelling, or whenever you want to feel focused and steady.
-> For intention-based wear, put it on before starting your day and use it as a reminder to stay confident, protected, and action-oriented. 
-> You can wear it alone for a clean look or pair it with a watch or other minimal bracelets for a stronger style statement.
-> To maintain its finish, keep the bracelet away from water, perfumes, sweat, and harsh chemicals. Store it in a clean, dry place when not in use.

 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Tiger Eye & Obsidian Protection Bracelet – Courage in Balance

Harness fearless energy and deep grounding with the Tiger Eye & Obsidian Protection Bracelet. This striking combination of Tiger Eye, the crystal of confidence and clarity, and Black Obsidian, the stone of protection and truth, forms a powerful talisman for strength and stability.

Tiger Eye empowers your decision-making and enhances focus, while Obsidian shields you from negativity and emotional blockages. Together, they balance courage with calm — creating a steady flow of determination and inner security. Perfect for those navigating challenges or seeking to stay aligned amidst chaos.

Why You’ll Love It

• 🐯 Tiger Eye for Confidence – Supports courage, focus, and bold action
• 🖤 Black Obsidian for Protection – Helps shield from negativity and unwanted energy
• 🎯 Ambition + Grounding Balance – Keeps you motivated yet steady
• ✨ Premium Half-and-Half Design – Bold, clean, and easy to style
• 🧿 Ideal for Daily Wear – Comfortable, meaningful, and versatile

 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Q. What is Ambition Protection Bracelet used for?

It is commonly used for confidence, courage, focus, ambition, protection, grounding, and nazar shielding.

Q. Which crystals are used in this bracelet?

This bracelet is made with Tiger Eye crystal and Black Obsidian crystal.

Q. Who can wear this bracelet?

It is suitable for men and women who want protection energy along with confidence, focus, and goal-driven motivation.

Q. Can I wear it daily?

Yes, it can be worn daily during work, business meetings, travel, important tasks, or regular routines.

Q. Which wrist should I wear it on?

Wear it on your right wrist when you want to project confidence and action energy. Wear it on your left wrist when you want to receive grounding and protective energy.
